main_idea: Warmup raises Nemotron 3 Ultra’s GDPval score close to the specialized teacher.
ideas: Warmup improves the student’s GDPval score toward the teacher.
The warmup result is 2.8 points below the teacher.
summary: A slogan, explanatory copy, footer, and oversized repeated takeaway clutter an otherwise complete chart.
